criteria.notes: The published map package drives the 2D and 3D maps, directory, localized filters, selected destination, reviewed route, and turn-by-turn visitor guidance.
Northline geometry, destinations, graph topology, calibrated distances, media, labels, and camera framing remain sourced from the authored Studio project.
The architectural map, persistent spatial labels, route flow, arrival treatment, and compact directory read as a purpose-built wayfinding product.
Primary headings, map labels, directory rows, route steps, and distance summary remain legible at Full HD and 1366x768 without clipped text ink.
Both the light and dark kiosk chrome retain clear hierarchy and readable controls; the authored floor plate remains intentionally light for map contrast.
Destination and status text clamp safely, the directory uses bounded scrolling, and the selected detail hierarchy fits without control or text overlap.
The map stays dominant. In the selected 2D state the destination list compresses cleanly so photo, metadata, route steps, and distance remain visible without panel overflow.
The bundled wbmap supplies coordinated map colors, media, labels, and graph data; branded symbol and photo assets render correctly in both presentation modes.
The semantic 2D and extruded 3D map surfaces, graph-derived directions, and spatial controls are materially distinct from dashboard and editorial examples.

screenshots.notes: Full-HD 3D view is nonblank, correctly framed, and preserves a balanced map-to-directory composition.
Compact 3D keeps the complete control structure readable while the bounded destination list communicates scroll availability.
Default scenario matches the primary Full-HD composition with stable authored camera framing.
Compact scenario has no clipped controls, panel collisions, or horizontal overflow.
Dark theme retains strong contrast for headings, filters, directory rows, status labels, and the active view toggle.

Selected 2D state clearly shows all authored spaces, the highlighted destination, cased directional route flow, arrival marker, photo, deterministic turn steps, and calibrated distance without overflow.
